question: Which way points to the closest nature reserve from Fran Rish Stadium, Richland, WA?
sql:
SELECT *, degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-119.286251 46.275954)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) AS angle  FROM pois
WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve'
ORDER BY geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-119.286251 46.275954)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

answers.poi_name: Trout Lake Big Tree Interpretive Site
